Docs.summary: A that echoes the per-request x-agent-foundry-call-id from the ambient on every outbound request (container protocol version 2.0.0).

remarks.para: Add this handler to any that calls Foundry platform services (toolbox MCP, Files, Memories, Indexes, project Responses/Chat) so the call id is attached automatically, instead of stamping it per call.

Only x-agent-foundry-call-id is attached; x-agent-user-id is never echoed — the receiver resolves user identity from the call id. When no call id is present (protocol 1.0.0 or local development) the request is forwarded unchanged.
